The main takeaway from our work is that

HRV based stress is an objective indicator of stress in real life and that it can be used in research to investigate how stress is affected by PA, cardioresporatory fitness, and obesity related health risk factors.
HRV based stress can be used as a complementary method to measure stress in addition to self report questionnaires.
